name: Cornelius Pryce
blurb: Founder of Pryce Transcontinental Air. Charming, theatrical, used to winning.

name: Vivienne Pryce
blurb: Former stage actress. Sardonic, immaculate, calls you 'Inspector, darling'.

name: Capt. Wilhelmina 'Billie' Strand
blurb: Brash, funny, superstitious. Burn-scarred hands. Won't talk about the Marigold.

name: Dr. Matthias Lindqvist
blurb: Gentle, anxious, precise. His hands tremble.

name: Julian Ferreira-Blake
blurb: Smooth and over-polite. Never raises his voice. Hums opera.

name: Abel 'Ox' Brennan
blurb: Huge, gentle, slow-spoken and devout. Keeps pigeons. A bad liar.

name: Tamsin Quill
blurb: Brusque, chain-smoking, deadpan. Says openly that she hated him.

name: Walter Hobbs
blurb: Kind, half-deaf and rambling. Thinks the wires are haunted.

name: Agent Danny Cole
blurb: Former filing clerk, proud of his neat reports. Calls you 'Chief'.
